latestAction.text: Placed on Senate Legislative Calendar under General Orders. Calendar No. 574.

summary.text: This bill designates the facility of the U.S. Postal Service located at 840 Front Street in Casselton, North Dakota, as the Commander Delbert Austin Olson Post Office.

title: A bill to designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 840 Front Street in Casselton, North Dakota, as the "Commander Delbert Austin Olson Post Office".
